Unlike the Langreth convolution, the star below is a componentwise product.
We define the componentwise product in the stated order by $C=A*B$.
Consequently its lesser component is
\begin{equation}
C^{<}=A^{<}\,B^{<}.\label{componentwise-lesser}
\end{equation}
